ModMetaData.name: Hemophage Warcasket
ModMetaData.author: Sam Hunt
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the Hemophage, a 10th-generation warcasket for Vanilla Factions Expanded - Pirates made for sanguophages and any other hemogenic pilot, built at the warcasket foundry like any other set.
The armor can spend the pilot's hemogen to make them much faster and stronger. The shoulders let the pilot tear a limb off an enemy, and a hemogenic pilot can drain hemogen from unwilling targets this way. The helmet protects the pilot's brain, shields them from sunlight and steadies them near fire.
Supports CE, Vanilla Gravship Expanded, Vanilla Races Expanded - Sanguophage and SOS2.
